caption:
Leads are slipping through your follow-up gap right now.

You just don't have the number attached to it.

The Revenue Calculator takes four inputs: monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and current response time.

It returns three numbers: revenue per lead, what slow follow-up costs you monthly, and what a 10% improvement in leads, close rate, or repeat rate is worth over a year.

No signup. No card. Four fields for the real number behind your ad spend.

rationale: Offers/Lead Magnets is under-served this cycle and the Revenue Calculator is the only free tool left out of the last full rotation (Response Audit, AI Follow-Up Builder, Black Arrow OS, Ad ROI Calculator), shown as a single promo card, the format that converts fastest for one clear offer.
